prompt: Clean technical isometric cutaway illustration, axonometric projection. Extreme asymmetric framing, positioned off-centre right with generous empty margin. A stylized modular electric freight charging bay and battery rack, constructed directly atop a thick, tiered paper ledger structure representing carbon accounting. Flat muted industrial grey palette with one striking mint green accent colour highlighting the power conduit. Thin consistent line weight, laid over a weathered concrete drafting floor. cue: onto the carbon ledger, not the pump
subject: isometric cutaway of an electric freight charging bay resting on a layered financial ledger
core_thesis: At $6-plus diesel, fuel savings alone do not close the electric-truck cost gap, forcing shippers to use carbon certificates to bridge the financial divide.
core_conflict: Physical pump savings versus the actual hardware and infrastructure cost of electric freight.
alt_text: Electric freight charging bay built on top of a layered financial ledger in an isometric cutaway.
caption: Shippers are bridging the electric freight cost gap not with fuel savings, but with carbon certificates.
title: electric-freight-carbon-ledger-isometric
